cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.

mechanism: Treat packing and deciding about jam as successive lessons for a former pupil, using B's practical solution to create a different reason to remain.
confusable: Not generic parental fussing: A must claim influence over a specific packing judgment and convert B's refusal into another unfinished lesson without saying stay.
comparison: Hands occupied in packing/gift choice rather than a tasting exam tied to train timing.
seedUse: Retains jar in train jumper, leaving jam and spoon response; sharpens patronizing training throughout.
